issues.issue: The printed line is 378,119. The page doesn't support moving the 200,000 out of 2610. All the pages show is that the transfer sits somewhere in the 2600 Operation and maintenance of plant group as a whole. Statement p5 O&M 732,748 = schedule lines 2610 378,119 + 2620 361,815 + 2630 30,412 + 2650 77,461 (= 847,807, p10) + Depreciation capital outlay 84,941 (p12) - 200,000 Transfer from the General Fund (p12). Every other function on p4-p5 ties to its schedule lines exactly (Employee Benefit 631 is in Central services), so the 200,000 can only be in O&M. But no page says which O&M line holds it. 2620 (361,815) could hold it just as well as 2610, and so could a mix of lines. 2610 as recorded (178,119) is printed nowhere, so it misstates a printed line. Fix: put 2610 back to 378,119 as printed, with no computed/split_from. Keep 2620/2630/2650 as printed. Record the reclassification at group level: (a) a computed expenditure contra item, department 'Operation and maintenance of plant', amount -200,000, split_from '2600 Operation and maintenance of plant, lines 2610-2650, 847,807 (p10)', review 'line holding the transfer not shown; elimination from p5 O&M 732,748 and p12'; (b) the existing other financing -200,000 (detail[73]) with the same group-level split_from. Detail_totals still reconcile after this: expenditure lines 8,414,292 - 200,000 + |other financing out| 250,000 = 8,464,292 (p11).
